items.title: Hilb^d of a curve is smooth proper of dimension d with degree formula
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter pic.tex (Picard Schemes of Curves)
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file pic.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: Prove the three-part structure theorem for Hilb^d of a geometrically irreducible smooth proper curve: representability from proposition-hilb-d-representable plus projectivity; separatedness (lemma-hilb-d-separated) and smoothness (lemma-hilb-d-smooth); build X^d -> Hilb^d by (x_1,...,x_d) |-> x_1 + ... + x_d via lemma-universal-object and induction, finite locally free of degree d!; properness of Hilb^d since X^d is proper and the morphism surjective onto its image (morphisms-lemma-image-proper-is-proper); irreducibility since X^d is irreducible (geometrically irreducible factors); part (2) is the point-divisor dictionary by definition; part (3): the addition morphism Hilb^{d_1} x Hilb^{d_2} -> Hilb^{d_1+d_2} is finite locally free of degree binom(d_1+d_2, d_1) by the commutative diagram with X^{d_1} x X^{d_2} = X^{d_1+d_2} and multiplicativity of degrees.
